stem:
The graph shows rainfall in millimetres for City P and City Q across four months.

Which claim about this display is correct?

options.text: A line graph with two lines shows how each city's rainfall changes across the months and makes the comparison clear.
The graph is a pie chart of the rainfall totals.
Clustered bars for every month are required, because a line graph cannot show two cities.
Only the tallest plotted point matters for comparing the two cities.

teacher.key_rationale: Two time series are compared clearly by two lines across months. The display is not a pie chart, line graphs can show two cities, and the full paths matter—not only the single tallest point.
teacher.figure_note: Line graph of rainfall for City P and City Q over Jan–Apr.
